opening.argument: The video is presented as a personal birthday surprise, with the title announcing a brand-new car for the creator's assistant and the narration explaining, "Today is Natalie's birthday. So I decided to get her something nice." That framing describes general entertainment and does not solicit investments, prize payments, or sensitive information. The commercial message is also transparent: the description says, "Thanks to SeatGeek for sponsoring the video," while the narration identifies SeatGeek as a ticket-buying app and offers $20 off a first purchase with a promo code. Although the Snapchat invitation is an off-platform engagement request, the available evidence does not establish any payment requirement, private-data request, transaction outcome, or deceptive destination.
